_comment: An SCA submission (src/ + xpi/) whose shipped XPI IS the submitted source: readable and non-minified (hasUnreviewableCode false), no transpiled source kind, and its one script byte-identical to src/background.js. All three questions in resolveXpiOnlyAdvice (src/pipeline.js) therefore pass and sca-not-required fires (info) to tell the developer an XPI-only submission would have done. The review is NOT re-routed - this stays a full SCA review, so the src/ tree IS reviewed and the build checks DO run; that is why src/ carries a package.json. Complements the unit-level coverage in sca-pipeline.test.js with end-to-end report rendering. The finding names NO file - its subject is the submission as a whole - so the harness records it as (add-on) and the report prints the entry with no locus line at all.
